units.en: We're building a smarter, more connected organization | where knowledge flows freely and intelligent decisions happen faster | to make Lenovo the model for a Knowledge + AI-Driven future.
units.zh: 我们正在打造一个更智能、联系更紧密的组织，| 让知识自由流动，让明智的决策更快发生，| 从而把联想打造成知识 + AI 驱动未来的典范。

units.en: We are building a culture | where knowledge management is a natural part of every employee's daily work.
units.zh: 我们正在打造一种文化，| 让知识管理自然融入每位员工的日常工作。

units.en: Then, knowledge becomes a strategic advantage | that helps Lenovo move faster, work smarter, and lead in the age of AI.
units.zh: 这样，知识就会成为一项战略优势，| 帮助联想行动更快、工作更聪明，并在 AI 时代保持领先。

units.en: Each of us has a role to drive Lenovo's future.
units.zh: 我们每个人都能为推动联想的未来发挥作用。

source_text: We're building a smarter, more connected organization where knowledge flows freely and intelligent decisions happen faster to make Lenovo the model for a Knowledge + AI-Driven future. We are building a culture where knowledge management is a natural part of every employee's daily work. Then, knowledge becomes a strategic advantage that helps Lenovo move faster, work smarter, and lead in the age of AI. Knowledge powers AI. Each of us has a role to drive Lenovo's future.
